pr_body:
Removes the connected and disconnected callbacks.
Removes the recv callback for broadcast source. 
Guards the callbacks to only exist for specific roles. 

fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41188
pr_comments: @Casper-Bonde-Bose please approve if your issue is addressed

issue_context.title: LE Audio: Remove stream (dis)connected callback from stream ops
issue_context.body:
For connected/disconnected, use started/stopped instead.

For unicast, those are the states that really matters.

For broadcast, those are also used, although not part of a control point operations.

The remaining callbacks should be guarded for only unicast audio.

review_comments: Don't we need this somewhere to release the timer?
Is something being done for this?
@cvinayak The `k_work_cancel_delayable(&audio_send_work);` was moved to the `stopped` callback instead
What is the pattern for when the removed callbacks are replaced with others, and for when they are just removed?
They were removed from the unicast streams, as they already had `started` and `stopped`. For broadcast `connected` was replaced with `started`, and `disconnected` replaced by `stopped`.
